content.text:
Fixed. Both tests pass.

The bug was in `num_pages` in `repo/paging.py`: it used floor division (`total // per_page`), which drops the partial final page. So 101 rows at 10 per page reported 10 pages instead of 11. I switched it to ceiling division (`(total + per_page - 1) // per_page`). Exact multiples are unaffected (100 rows still gives 10). `old_page_count` delegates to `num_pages`, so it's fixed too.
